load_olivetti_faces_dataset: load the Olivetti faces dataset using sklearn.datasets.fetch_olivetti_faces for face image analysis
create_minibatch_kmeans_clustering: create a MiniBatchKMeans clusterer with 81 clusters for online face patch learning
extract_2d_image_patches: extract 2D image patches of size 20x20 from face images using extract_patches_2d
run_incremental_kmeans_fit: run incremental kmeans clustering with partial_fit on batches of extracted face patches
plot_cluster_centers_as_patches: plot kmeans cluster centers as 20x20 face patches using matplotlib imshow grid
